I’ll start by thinking about a little ache, and then I’m down the rabbit hole, imagining worst‑case scenarios, trying to remember every symptom I’ve ever had. Sometimes it feels tied to how low I’m feeling since my husband died; other times it just pops up on its own and won’t let go.  

It’s not like I’m doing anything strange or ritualistic, but mentally I just circle the same thoughts. I know it’s not normal to dwell like this, but I can’t seem to switch it off.
